Subject: Planning: Targets & Scenario Timeline — initiation and packet

Team,

Starting the annual planning conversation for FY27 (targets, scenario framing, and timeline). I attached a short planning packet and a set of scenario templates to get us aligned — please treat the packet as a read-ahead. Goals for this thread: align on top-line targets, agree owners for each scenario, and lock a 60-minute working session to finalize assumptions.

Quick context (two lines):
- We need top-line revenue and ops targets by Aug 14 to feed the exec QBR material.
- Finance needs the baseline + two downside scenarios and a blue-sky by Aug 12 to model headcount and capital.

Asks:
- Read the packet (attached) and identify any missing datapoints (note them inline in the Drive doc linked below).
- Send me your proposed top-line target and three priority assumptions by EOD Aug 7.
- Owner nominations: who will lead Baseline, Downside A, Downside B, and Upside?
- Can we meet for a 60-min working session to consolidate assumptions? Suggested windows below.

Suggested sync windows (pick one):
- Wed Aug 5, 3:00–4:00pm PT
- Thu Aug 6, 11:00–12:00pm PT

Attachments: 2026_planning_brief.pdf, scenario_templates.xlsx
Related Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPlanningPacket

Thanks — please respond with availability and owners.

-David

David Kim

I also attached a short markdown note with the first-pass assumptions I drafted this morning (initial_assumptions.md). Nothing final — just to seed the discussion.

Agenda (60 min):
- 0–10m: confirm owners and success criteria for each scenario
- 10–35m: assumption walkthrough (owner-led)
- 35–50m: translate assumptions to topline and ops impacts (finance + product)
- 50–60m: action items and next steps (deliverables & deadlines)

Action items so far:
- Laura: reconcile ARR lines in packet by Aug 7
- Jonas: upload demand_model_v1.csv by EOD Tue Aug 4
- All: send top-line target + 3 priority assumptions by Aug 7

Subject: Planning: quick baseline numbers (read before Wed)

Folks — one quick note ahead of tomorrow: I sketched a baseline topline for discussion so we start with a common anchor. Please treat these as conversation starters, not final asks.

Baseline (FY27):
- Revenue target: $148M ARR (+38% YoY)
- Gross margin target: 62%
- Net new ACV target: $10.5M

Downside contingencies to model (for Wed):
- Downside A: Macro contraction — 15% conversion drop + 20% sales cycle lengthening
- Downside B: Competition price pressure — 12% deflation in ASP in low-touch segments

Please confirm owners if anything above looks off — otherwise we'll use this as the starting point in the session.

Drive doc (updated): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPlanningPacket

-David
